body: - 2026-11-13: A vt100 row read back keeps every space that was fed to it, a trailing one included (a prompt row fed `❯ ` reads `"❯ "`), so an oracle over a fed row is copied from what was fed, never trimmed by eye.

- 2026-11-13: No gate builds the separate `fuzz/` workspace, so a change to a type its targets construct is compile-checked on the pinned nightly of `fuzz/rust-toolchain.toml`, offline and installing nothing, under a kill deadline: `RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 timeout -k 10 600 cargo +<nightly> check --offline --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --bins`.

- 2026-10-10: On the Linux dev host the bare name `claude` can resolve to a newer CLI than the home is stamped for, so a live rig that needs the stamped version puts that version's install directory first on its host process's `PATH` and reads `claude --version` by path before its first start; a `viola revive` typed there with no `PATH` change runs the unstamped CLI. Extended 2026-10-20: `claude --mcp-config <configs...>` is variadic, so a rig that passes it gives the prompt on stdin with nothing positional after the option, and files the CLI's stderr privately, recording only its byte count and hash prefix — a start that exits early otherwise leaves no cause to read. Extended 2026-11-13: the newest installed CLI can move between a plan and its live proof (a `mise`-managed `latest`), so a plan entry naming a CLI version by literal is re-read against `mise ls claude` at the proof, and a newer install moves the proof only on the operator's word.

The readiness read of the claude screen now counts the input box as up when a footer literal stands OR the box's own rows stand (a rule row of at least 40 box-drawing dashes directly above a row opening the prompt char), and never while a modal literal is on screen; one predicate decides for verify's guards, the input-box-signature ledger row and viola run's pre-send readiness gate.
viola run's pre-send gate therefore reads a screen ready on the box's rows alone; its quiet period, GATE_MAX_WAIT and poisoned arms are unchanged, and verify's settle and box waits still also end on a modal literal.
A recorded screen fixture keeps a box row as its literal alone (the dash run, or the prompt char alone, never the text after it); the fixture walk refuses any other form, and a recording refuses where the prompt row holds a home path, user word or email.
verify's typed run measures box_only_guards (guards passed on the box with no footer literal) into the ledger stamps' measured.typed_probe; the relied ledger rows stay 24 and the live proof ran on claude 2.1.323.
Supply chain: three reasoned cargo-deny advisory ignores for disabled rmcp features, and rustix bumped 1.1.5 to 1.1.6 in the lockfile; CI green.

body:
The session moved the readiness reading of the claude screen from footer literals alone to one predicate: the input box is up when no row holds a modal literal and either a footer literal stands or the box's own rows stand (a rule row of at least 40 box-drawing chars directly above a row opening the prompt char).
That predicate now decides verify's typed-run guards, the input-box-signature ledger row's check, and viola run's pre-send readiness gate, so the gate reads a screen ready on the box's rows alone; its quiet period, GATE_MAX_WAIT and poisoned arms are unchanged.
Recorded screen fixtures now keep a box row as its literal alone (the rule run, the bare prompt char); the fixture walk refuses any other form, and a recording refuses where the box's prompt row holds a home path, user word or email.
The ledger stamps envelope's measured.typed_probe gains box_only_guards (an integer or null), the count of verify guards that passed on the box alone; no version bump.
The supply-chain gate went green: cargo deny now ignores three rmcp advisories, each reasoned to a disabled or banned rmcp feature and standing until rmcp leaves its <3.5 range; a lockfile bump of rustix clears a fourth; no crate added.
The newest claude CLI, 2.1.323, was verified live and stamped (23 pass, 1 fail on statusline-rate-limits; 24 relied rows unchanged).

viola verify's typed run turn guards over the real CLI's screen, now counting guards passed on the box alone
viola verify's PTY probe settle and box-wait over the claude screen (ends on the input box or a modal literal)
viola verify's typed runs (the trusted run and Run B's ready guard) that write the measured typed probe stamps
viola run's pre-send readiness gate (wait_ready) on a verified CLI; one test case added, no code changed
the fixture hygiene contract test that walks recorded screen fixtures and refuses any row that is not a signature row
the cargo deny configuration of the supply-chain gate (advisories ignore list, banned features)
the dependency lockfile (rustix bumped 1.1.5 to 1.1.6)
the vt100 feed fuzz target that constructs the screen signatures

body: The readiness gate's span and the send-refused input-not-ready detail: viola run's pre-send readiness gate now reads a screen ready on the input box's rows alone, so a row that says when the gate reads ready or refuses input-not-ready (decision/manual-readiness-gate-span, contract/send-span-attributes/run-readiness-gate, contract/send-refused-detail/input-not-ready) may be stale in what readiness means; the span, its attributes and the detail word themselves are unchanged.

No telemetry from screen content (decision/no-telemetry-from-screen, decision/no-telemetry-from-screen-content): the screen is now read for two more compiled literals, the box's rule and prompt chars; still compiled signatures only and nothing of a row is logged, a row saying the screen is read only for signature literals stays true but may name the literal set.

Recorded fixtures are no telemetry source and claude fixtures are scrub-required (decision/fixtures-not-telemetry, decision/fixtures-not-a-telemetry-source, decision/claude-fixtures-scrub-required): the recorded screen form now keeps a box row as its literal alone, and a recording refuses where the box's prompt row holds a home path, user word or email.

The capability ledger and its stamps (decision/ledger-contents-never-logged, decision/verify-sole-stamps-writer, contract/run-log-parse-rejected/ledger-stamps): the stamps envelope's measured.typed_probe gains box_only_guards, written by verify alone; run reads no field of it, so a parse-rejected ledger-stamps line has no new cause.

viola verify's lines and stdout (decision/verify-lines-redacted, decision/verify-lines-carry-no-content, contract/verify-stdout/step-line, contract/verify-stdout/summary-line): verify's typed-run guards now read the box predicate and count box-only passes; the step and summary lines and the relied count 24 are unchanged, so any row holding that count stays true.

cargo deny gates (decision/obs-deps-pass-cargo-deny, decision/cargo-deny-failure-fails, decision/banned-telemetry-dependencies): the advisories ignore list goes from empty to three reasoned rmcp ignores; a row that says obs dependencies pass cargo deny with no ignore, or that the deny configuration ignores nothing, is touched.

vt100 panic containment and the fuzz target (decision/vt100-panics-contained, decision/vt100-feed-panic-contained): the screen signatures type the fuzz target builds gained two fields; the feed and its containment are unchanged.

Real-CLI verify never in CI and CI verify against the fake agent only (decision/real-cli-verify-never-in-ci, decision/ci-verify-fake-agent-only): the live verify on claude 2.1.323 ran by hand on the dev host, and no box-only screen fixture replayed by the fake agent was added; both rows stay true.

Wrapped claude internals are not a contract (decision/claude-internals-not-a-contract, decision/transcripts-not-a-contract): readiness now leans on the input box's drawn rule and prompt chars, another rendering of the claude screen read as a version-stamped signature, not a contract.
The diagnostics line schema, its event enum, field names, detail codes and corr rules: no event, field, detail word or exit code was added, renamed or removed.
The hook, MCP, channel, dialog, wheel and budget paths with their spans and log fields: none of them changed.

Panic capture, error reporting, the NEVER-log floor and the absences of exporters, reporters and network egress: no telemetry dependency or sink was added; the only dependency move is a lockfile bump of a non-telemetry crate.
Perf budgets, hyperfine gates, heartbeat liveness, log file locations, rotation and service identity: untouched.
Secret scan, artifact upload and retention rows in CI: no CI step, job or upload changed; the supply-chain job reads the existing deny configuration.

body:
The readiness check on the claude screen now reads the input box as up when a footer literal stands OR the box's own rows stand (a rule row of at least 40 box-drawing chars directly above a row opening the prompt char), and never while a modal literal is on screen; one predicate decides for verify's guards, the input-box-signature ledger row and viola run's pre-send readiness gate.
The two new box chars are compiled signature literals beside the two footer and two modal literals; the founder ratified this live as a boundary widening (F2).
A recorded screen fixture keeps a box rule row as its rule chars alone and a prompt row as the prompt char alone; the fixture walk refuses any box row holding more, and a recording refuses as unclean-fixture where the live prompt row holds a home path, the user word or an email.
cargo-deny's advisory ignore list goes from empty to three reasoned entries (RUSTSEC-2026-0457, -0461, -0462), each in an rmcp feature that is banned or off in the release graph, standing until rmcp leaves its below-3.5 range; the founder ratified them (F1). rustix moved 1.1.5 to 1.1.6 in the lockfile alone, clearing RUSTSEC-2026-0486; CI supply-chain is green again.
verify's typed probe now records how many guards passed on the box alone (box_only_guards) in the stamps file's measured block; the live proof ran on the newest installed claude CLI.

decision/cve-sla-disabled-feature (Critical CVE response for a disabled feature): the rule this session applied — its response for a CVE in a disabled feature is now the reasoned ignore until rmcp leaves its range; check the row says so.

The rmcp ban rows (decision/rmcp-banned-features, decision/rmcp-http-server-and-auth-banned, decision/no-rmcp-http-or-auth-features, decision/rmcp-feature-set, decision/rmcp-features-exact): indirect — each ignore's reason rests on the auth feature and the Streamable HTTP server and client transports staying banned or off; the feature set itself is unchanged (server plus transport-io, rmcp 3.4.1).

decision/fixture-scrub-and-refusal, decision/fixture-recording-scrubbed and decision/fixture-hygiene: the scrub-or-refuse rule now reaches the box rows' seams — a recording refuses whole where the live prompt row beside a kept rule row holds a home path, the user word or an email.

contract/verify-refusal-codes/unclean-fixture and contract/fixture-refusal-codes/home-path, username, email: the same refusal codes now fire on an identifying input-box prompt row; codes and line form unchanged.

decision/verify-screen-read-against-literals, decision/verify-signature-only, decision/verify-reads-only-signatures: verify still reads only compiled literals, but the set grows by the box's rule and prompt chars and a box-only screen now reads ready.

decision/manual-dependency-updates and decision/exact-dependency-pins: rustix moved 1.1.5 to 1.1.6 in the lockfile alone by a precise update to clear RUSTSEC-2026-0486; no manifest pin changed, tempfile stays exactly pinned.

decision/no-assertion-beyond-compiled-literals - the compiled literals screen assertions may use grew by the box rule and prompt chars and a box-rule minimum of 40.

Rows that the rendered child screen is never parsed (decision/no-screen-parsing, decision/never-parse-rendered-child-screen, decision/no-child-screen-assertions, decision/tui-passthrough-never-parses-screen) - readiness now reads row shape (a rule row above a prompt row) for compiled chars; check they still hold as written.

The fixture hygiene walk (decision/fixture-hygiene-walk, decision/fixtures-walked-for-hygiene, decision/planted-hygiene-violations) - a screen row now passes as a signature row when it holds one of four literals, is exactly the prompt char, or is rule chars alone; anything else on such a row is refused NotASignatureRow; the walk's literal list went 4 to 6.

Screen fixture scrub and recording rows (decision/screen-fixture-scrub-as-detector, decision/recorder-scrub, decision/dirty-payload-refuses-recording, decision/scrubbed-fixtures) - a recorded box row is kept as its literal alone, and the recording refuses where the live prompt row next to a kept rule row holds a home path, user word or email.
contract/verify-exit-detail/unclean-fixture and contract/process-exit-detail/unclean-fixture - a new cause reaches unclean-fixture: an input-box prompt row holding identifying text.

Fake-agent and fixture replay rows (decision/fake-agent-matches-verify-fixtures, decision/fixtures-per-cli-version, decision/replay-every-cli-version-fixture, decision/fake-agent-replays-recorded-bytes) - the recorded screen form changed; every stamped set replays at 0 fail on the new predicate; no box-only screen fixture is replayed in CI yet.
decision/record-only-at-zero-failing-rows - it is why no box-only fixture could be recorded: verify on this account fails statusline-rate-limits.

Ledger rows (decision/ledger-row-verify-probe, decision/version-gate-needs-all-relied-rows, decision/ledger-probe-contract-suite) - the input-box-signature row's check now reads the box predicate; its id and the relied count 24 are unchanged.

Stamps from verify (decision/stamps-written-only-by-verify, decision/stamps-only-from-verify, decision/verify-sole-stamp-writer) - verify now writes box_only_guards into the stamps' measured typed-probe record; still verify alone.

Real-CLI and compat rows (decision/compat-tests-for-cli-versions, decision/real-claude-local-only, decision/live-verify-never-in-ci) - the live verify ran locally on claude 2.1.323, a version newer than the plan named.

Indirect: fuzz rows (decision/fuzz-separate-workspace, decision/fuzzing-with-cargo-fuzz, decision/fuzz-toolchain-single-source, decision/vt100-feed-panic-safe) - the vt100 fuzz target builds screen signatures and changed with them; no gate builds the fuzz workspace, so it was compile-checked by hand on the pinned nightly.

body_fields.fact: The input box reads up when no row holds a modal literal and either a footer literal stands or a box-rule row (at least 40 rule chars alone) stands directly above a row opening the prompt char; this one predicate decides verify's guards, the input-box-signature row and viola run's readiness gate.

A recorded screen fixture keeps a box rule row as its rule chars alone and a prompt row below it as the prompt char alone; the hygiene walk refuses a prompt row with text after the prompt char or a rule row with other text.
A screen recording refuses as unclean-fixture where the input box's prompt row holds a home path, the user word or an email, since a kept rule row's seam is that whole live row.

Exception to no ignored advisories: an advisory that sits only in an rmcp feature banned or off in the release graph is ignored with a reason naming that feature, standing until rmcp leaves <3.5 (RUSTSEC-2026-0457, -0461, -0462).
No gate entry builds the fuzz workspace; a change to a type its targets construct needs a compile check on the pinned fuzz nightly, offline and with no toolchain install, under a kill deadline.

body: MCP, channel, JSON-RPC and wrapper-channel contracts and their error codes: no surface, refusal word or code changed.

viola send, wait, last, release, list and answer contracts and their exit codes: send confirmation, refusal order and wheel rules are unchanged; only the readiness verdict before a send reads a new arm.
Hook, dialog, decision-body, statusline and budget rows: no hook path, deadline, budget threshold or statusline behaviour changed.
Harness contract rows (boot, cleanup, status, run, gate breach, pre-push, session record, exit codes, local-live failure codes): no harness verb, status shape or gate step changed.
Coverage floors, mutation thresholds, perf budgets and kill lines: no threshold, floor or bound moved; no mutation run.
Log format, corr fields, event-line and process-log contracts: no log line or field changed.
CI workflow rows (artifacts, SHA-pinned actions, permissions, zizmor, toolchain pin, MSRV, caches): no workflow or job changed.
Filesystem strict modes, socket directory, peer admission, home read rule and run-start refusal rows: unchanged.
